decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment is distant from the firm's maritime and crewing knowledge, so the firm lacks the absorptive capacity to interpret results and improve the product commercially.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's established crew recruitment and maritime expertise, giving it the related knowledge to assimilate results and improve the product.
The maritime education programme builds on the firm's training and maritime knowledge, and the early result of six partner institutions indicates effective assimilation and learning.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services are close to the firm's existing compliance and technical services, and the successful submission of all FuelEU Monitoring Plans shows applied related knowledge.
The emissions compliance dashboard builds on the firm's existing software and digital tools, and its integration into PAL indicates the firm can assimilate and develop it further.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool builds on the firm's existing software and digital tools, aligning with the firm's digitalisation and maritime knowledge, so the firm can learn and improve it.
